item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 28/Mar/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of the northeast monsoon, it will be windy over the coast of Guangdong tomorrow. Meanwhile, an upper-air disturbance will bring showers and thunderstorms to the region. The monsoon is expected to moderate midweek this week, the weather will improve gradually with temperatures rising slightly over the coast of southern China. Another surge of the northeast monsoon will bring cool weather to Guangdong in the latter part of this week to early next week.
